args.body: Use the existing catalogue pilot handoff and the direct catalogue readback to reconcile the pre-send link and offer conditions for the exact previously prepared draft. First reuse any committed operator send or decline receipt. If the draft depends on wording present only in the commissioned-review candidate, identify the exact dependency and keep the handoff pending verified deployment. If the current live offer supports the draft, give the authorized operator the existing handoff and exact draft reference once, with a clear send-or-decline decision. No external send by agents. Keep pilot exposure, eligible replies, acceptance and Treasury settlement separate.
